# Version 4.154.0
> **GPU reliability and packaged docs** · Released October 12, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.154.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 brings Skia m154, more reliable GPU failure handling, and packaged compiler XML documentation.

## Breaking Changes

- **Rename UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133** — HarfBuzzSharp corrects CCC133 to CCC132, retaining numeric value 132 but providing no compatibility alias. Replace source references to UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 with UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC132. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **Replace GlyphFlags.Defined masks** — HarfBuzzSharp removes GlyphFlags.Defined and does not expose the other aggregate Defined masks. Combine the concrete flags your code requires instead of using an aggregate of every flag in one HarfBuzz release. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **Use an external RAW decoder** — Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode RAW files with an external reader and pass decoded pixels or a supported encoded format to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains value 10 for compatibility but does not indicate codec availability. Standalone JPEG decoding remains available. ([#5190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5190))

## Engine

- **Skia m154** — Updates the bundled engine to milestone 154 without changing the C API. HarfBuzz remains natively at 14.2.1; package revision 14.2.1.400 reserves the new milestone servicing line. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## Bug Fixes

- **Reliable glyph and GPU state** — Corrects partial glyph-atlas generation tracking and propagates Ganesh task, flush, and GPU-buffer upload failures. Unsupported asynchronous readbacks complete with a null result rather than leaving work unresolved. ([#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))
- **Failed-flush cache cleanup** — Drops uniquely held thread-safe cache entries after a failed Ganesh flush so subsequent draws cannot reuse textures that were never initialized. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed. ([#5253](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5253))
- **Windows HarfBuzz scanning compatibility** — Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged. — ❤️ [@azchohfi](https://github.com/azchohfi) ([#5111](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5111))
- **Matching Uno WebAssembly native assets** — Uno views depend on the matching HarfBuzz WebAssembly native-assets package, avoiding missing-symbol links caused by combining current managed bindings with an older archive. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## API Surface

- **Synchronized HarfBuzz enums** — Updates supported buffer, cluster, glyph, and baseline-tag values from the bundled native source without introducing new managed types. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **API documentation in NuGet packages** — Ships compiler-produced XML beside implementation and reference assemblies, making source-authored API documentation available to package consumers. ([#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

Synchronizes supported enum values with HarfBuzz 14.2.1, renames CCC133 to CCC132, and removes GlyphFlags.Defined; update those source references. Packages include compiler XML, and Windows native assets correct the BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error.
